# Olfaire
> AI fragrance intelligence for serious collectors

Olfaire is a mobile app that turns your perfume collection into a curated daily ritual. Guided by Lumi, an AI scent companion, it delivers daily fragrance picks, layering chemistry analysis, and a personalised Fragrance DNA profile.
